## Ridge trace plot
We visualize how regression coefficients change with different penalty parameter $\lambda$ in ridge regression:
$\hat{\beta}^{ridge} = (X^\top X + \lambda I)^{-1}X^\top y$


```{r ridge-plot}
lambda_seq <- exp(seq(log(0.1), log(500), length.out = 25))
coef_mat <- matrix(nrow = length(lambda_seq), ncol = 13)

form <- medv ~ crim + zn + indus + chas + nox + rm + age + dis + rad + tax + ptratio + b + lstat

for(i in seq_along(lambda_seq)){
  fit <- ridgereg(form, data = BostonHousing, lambda = lambda_seq[i])
  coef_mat[i,] <- coef(fit)[-1]
}

matplot(lambda_seq, coef_mat, type = "l", lty =1, log="x",
        xlab = "Lambda", ylab = "Coefficients",
        main = "Ridge trace plot, custom ridgereg function")
legend("topright", colnames(BostonHousing)[1:13], lty=1, col=1:13, cex=0.45)
```

```{r split-data}
set.seed(123)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(BostonHousing$medv, p=0.7, list = FALSE)
train_df <- BostonHousing[train_idx,]
test_df  <- BostonHousing[-train_idx,]
```

```{r lm-forward}
set.seed(123)
fit_lm <- train(medv ~ ., data = train_df, method = "lm", trControl = trainControl(method = "none"))
```

```{r caret-custom-model}
# Wrap custom `ridgereg()` for caret model interface.
ridgereg_caret <- list(
  label = "Ridge regression custom implementation",
  library = "mylinreg",
  type = "Regression",
  parameters = data.frame(parameter = "lambda", class = "numeric", label = "Penalty lambda"),
  grid = function(x, y, len = NULL, search = "grid") {
    data.frame(lambda = exp(seq(log(0.01), log(200), length.out = len)))
  },
  fit = function(x, y, wts, param, lev, last, classProbs, ...) {
    dat <- as.data.frame(x)
    dat$y <- y
    model <- ridgereg(y ~ ., data = dat, lambda = param$lambda)
    model$lambda <- param$lambda
    model
  },
  predict = function(modelFit, newdata, preProc = NULL, submodels = NULL) {
    predict(modelFit, newdata = newdata)
  },
  prob = NULL
)
```

```{r cv-ridge,eval=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(caret))
set.seed(123)

ridgereg_caret <- list(
  label = "Ridge regression custom implementation",
  library = "mylinreg",
  type = "Regression",
  parameters = data.frame(parameter = "lambda", class = "numeric", label = "Penalty lambda"),
  grid = function(x, y, len = NULL, search = "grid") {
    data.frame(lambda = exp(seq(log(0.01), log(200), length.out = len)))
  },
  fit = function(x, y, wts, param, lev, last, classProbs, ...) {
    dat <- as.data.frame(x)
    dat$y <- y
    model <- ridgereg(y ~ ., data = dat, lambda = param$lambda)
    model$lambda <- param$lambda
    model
  },
  predict = function(modelFit, newdata, preProc = NULL, submodels = NULL) {
    predict(modelFit, newdata = newdata)
  },
  prob = NULL
)

ctrl_cv <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10)
fit_ridge <- train(x = train_df[, !names(train_df) == "medv"],
                   y = train_df$medv,
                   method = ridgereg_caret,
                   trControl = ctrl_cv)

fit_ridge
```

```{r test-eval,eval=FALSE}
rmse <- function(obs, pred) sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2))

pred_lm <- predict(fit_lm, newdata = test_df)
pred_ridge <- predict(fit_ridge, newdata = test_df)

if (!is.null(fit_forward)) {
  pred_fwd <- predict(fit_forward, newdata = test_df)
  res_tab <- data.frame(
    Model = c("Ordinary lm","Forward selection","Ridge (best CV lambda)"),
    Test_RMSE = c(
      rmse(test_df$medv, pred_lm),
      rmse(test_df$medv, pred_fwd),
      rmse(test_df$medv, pred_ridge)
    )
  )
}else{
  res_tab <- data.frame(
    Model = c("Ordinary lm","Ridge (best CV lambda)"),
    Test_RMSE = c(
      rmse(test_df$medv, pred_lm),
      rmse(test_df$medv, pred_ridge)
    )
  )
}
print(res_tab)
```

## Conclusion
Compare test‑set RMSE among models. Discuss overfitting risk for ordinary regression and forward‑selection. Explain how ridge regularization mitigates overfitting by coefficient shrinkage, and comment on practical performance differences observed.
